decision: No runtime write privilege change is supported by the source audit.
reason: Each reference family has a service writer reachable from the pest-management CLI. Seed ownership therefore does not establish immutability; revoking DML would remove current operator customization behavior.
limitations: This is a repository-source audit; it does not establish live operator usage or external callers.
No migration, test, database, seed, candidate, legacy service, or provider was changed or used.
